description: Ask a real human — Emil Hyltoft Eriksen, Denmark — for his lived experience and personal opinion: 'what happened when I…', 'what would a real person actually do', 'how would this feel to a human'. Not facts, not professional medical/legal/financial advice. Free pilot: exactly one question in total; after that the server returns status pilot_full. Emil is testing whether agents find this useful at all. Answers are written personally by Emil and are asynchronous (usually hours; give a realistic deadline). Returns a question_id; poll get_answer(question_id). Include enough context to answer without follow-up.

agent_id.description: Optional stable id for your agent.

context.description: Background so Emil can answer without follow-up.

deadline.description: ISO 8601. When you need the answer by (at least 1 hour, at most 30 days ahead).

name: ask_human_perspective
title: Ask a real human
